scope: Independent source review and read-only hash/configuration/runtime preflight. No utility main function, candidate sealing, qualification process or inference executed.

issue_resolutions.issue: Post-run runtime/configuration/report-parse errors could leave the process receipt pending.
issue_resolutions.resolution: Post-run validation blocks now retain sanitized validation_errors, initialize failed defaults, require no validation errors for pass, and atomically replace the owned pending receipt with final failed/passed process evidence including exit code and elapsed time.

issue_resolutions.issue: The explicit Dart --packages configuration was not bound to the candidate/runtime identity.
issue_resolutions.resolution: package_configuration() validates workspace root routes for legacy_doc_parser, quds_office_engine and quds_proofing_spacy, hashes the actual package_config.json, includes that record in the seal, and compares it both before and after execution.

checks.source_map_matches_evaluator_algorithm: The same six fixed files and the same quds_office_engine/lib and quds_proofing_spacy/lib trees; the current source trees contain no symlinks.
checks.exclusive_artifacts: Candidate seal, runner receipt and stdout log use exclusive creation. The Dart evaluator exclusively reserves its report and consumed-seal claim before native loading. The runner only atomically finalizes its own admitted pending receipt.
checks.panel_access: Freeze utility reads the qualification hash from protocol.json; the process wrapper only names the panel as a Dart argument. Neither utility preflight opens case contents.
